headline: After SMBC, BTN Eyes Acquisition of Retirees' Loans Held by 2 Private Banks
summary: BTN is exploring the acquisition of pensioner loan portfolios from two private banks, following a previous deal involving SMBC. The report gives no transaction value.
why: Bank Tabungan Negara (BTN) is a state-owned Indonesian bank focused on housing finance, and portfolio acquisitions can change its loan book and risk profile.
original_headline: Usai SMBC, BTN Incar Akuisisi Kredit Pensiunan Milik 2 Bank Swasta
